maya.activity: Wake up, stretch quietly in bed, check Daniel's face and ask how he is feeling, then get dressed without pressing him to talk.
maya.intention: Start the day gently and assess whether Daniel needs anything before I begin chores.

maya.activity: Make ginger tea and a small breakfast for myself, carry Daniel a mug of tea and water, and leave a simple plate available for him without insisting he eat.
maya.intention: Keep both of us hydrated and fed while accommodating his low energy.

maya.activity: Set reusable grocery bags on the dining table, gather the laundry basket and sheet set, and clear only the items needed to change the bed.
maya.intention: Prepare for errands and laundry without making the shared surfaces into an ambitious Saturday project.

maya.activity: Wash the bed linens and a small load of towels, change the king bed with the clean sheet set, and leave the duvet and pillows arranged so Daniel can rest comfortably later.
maya.intention: Complete the essential laundry while keeping the bedroom usable and comfortable.

maya.activity: Move the clean clothes to the closet, fold them on the ottoman, and put away the everyday clothes while leaving worn-but-not-dirty items on the bedroom sofa.
maya.intention: Fold and store laundry without over-organizing while I am keeping an ear out for Daniel.

maya.activity: Take the reusable bags and shop for groceries at the market, choosing a shorter list of easy foods and fresh ginger rather than lingering at every stall.
maya.intention: Restock the house efficiently and avoid being away too long if Daniel needs me.

maya.activity: Bring the groceries home, put chilled items away, and set a few simple foods where they are easy to reach.
maya.intention: Make the afternoon and evening easier for both of us.

maya.activity: Check on Daniel in the living room, refresh his tea and water, and sit nearby for a quiet lunch while keeping my phone available.
maya.intention: Offer company and practical help without requiring conversation.

maya.activity: Put away the folded laundry, rinse the grocery bags, and make a short note of Daniel's symptoms and any medication timing.
maya.intention: Finish small necessary tasks while keeping track of his condition.

maya.activity: Wipe the kitchen counters and sink area, wash the used mugs and dishes, and leave the dining table mostly clear except for the grocery bags' drying spot.
maya.intention: Clean enough to make simple cooking and tea easy, rather than doing a full Saturday reset.

maya.activity: At the glass desk, sort planning papers into a short list, answer only urgent household notes, and stop before turning the afternoon into work.
maya.intention: Handle the planning papers without letting them compete with caring for Daniel.

maya.activity: Make a simple tomato soup and toast, carry a bowl and spoon to Daniel if he wants some, and eat at the kitchen counter myself.
maya.intention: Provide an easy dinner and conserve energy instead of making an elaborate meal.

maya.activity: Wash the saucepan, bowl, and spoon, put leftovers into a container, and lower the living-room lights before checking on Daniel again.
maya.intention: Leave the kitchen safe and make the evening environment calmer.

maya.activity: Sit with Daniel on the sectional while he rests, bring him tea or water as needed, and read quietly rather than expecting the usual dinner gathering.
maya.intention: Be attentive and give him a low-stimulation evening.

maya.activity: Check Daniel's temperature or symptoms if he agrees, write a brief note, put his phone and water within reach, and clear the coffee table into small destination piles.
maya.intention: Make the night easier and keep shared surfaces from quietly becoming a second illness.

maya.activity: Wash up, change into sleepwear, put my phone on charge, and prepare the king bed with the reading glasses left in the upper nightstand drawer.
maya.intention: Settle both of us for sleep while keeping essentials accessible.

maya.activity: Get into bed beside Daniel, keep water within reach, and settle quietly without asking him to make any decisions.
maya.intention: End the day calmly and stay available if he needs help.

daniel.activity: Wake in bedroom 1, check how Maya is feeling, shower, dress, and bring a glass of water to the bedside. I keep the room quiet and make sure she has her phone and anything she needs before going downstairs.
daniel.intention: Start the day gently and assess whether Maya needs immediate help.

daniel.activity: Make coffee and a mild breakfast in the kitchen, grinding the beans by hand and carrying my mug from the bar cabinet area to the counter. I prepare a small simple portion and tea for Maya, leave water within reach, and set the tasting spoon on the open sink side.
daniel.intention: Feed both of us without pressuring Maya to eat.

daniel.activity: Eat at the kitchen counter, then clear the most visible breakfast items and check Maya’s temperature and symptoms. I carry her mug or water to her resting place if she wants it and leave my phone on the bar cart while I move between the counter and the sink.
daniel.intention: Keep breakfast orderly while quietly monitoring her condition.

daniel.activity: Make a short essential grocery run for broth ingredients, fruit, tea, and easy food, carrying the reusable grocery bag and returning directly rather than visiting the music shop. I leave the house only after checking that Maya is settled and can reach her phone.
daniel.intention: Restock gentle meals while minimizing time away from home.

daniel.activity: Put away the groceries, make a small saucepan of plain broth, and carry a bowl, water, and a simple snack to Maya. I wash the saucepan and leave the tasting spoon on the sink side rather than starting a full kitchen cleanup.
daniel.intention: Give Maya something easy to tolerate and preserve my energy for the rest of the day.

daniel.activity: Eat a light lunch at the counter, refill my water bottle, and sit nearby for a quiet check-in. I gather only the most obvious dishes and leave the rest until later so I can remain available without hovering.
daniel.intention: Eat enough to stay useful and give Maya calm company.

daniel.activity: Do a short block of work in bedroom 2, setting up the work laptop on its stand and writing a priority list. I keep the door open and take a break halfway through to check whether Maya needs water, broth, or medicine.
daniel.intention: Handle only essential work while keeping caregiving interruptions easy.

daniel.activity: Return to the living room, make tea, and check Maya’s symptoms again. If she is sleeping comfortably, I sit on the sectional with water and keep the room quiet rather than practicing piano.
daniel.intention: Support her rest and avoid adding noise or unnecessary activity.

daniel.activity: Clear the kitchen’s most visible surfaces, wash the breakfast and lunch dishes, and put the groceries away properly. I leave the phone on the bar cart and set any tasting spoon on the sink side as usual.
daniel.intention: Prevent the illness-related mess from becoming tomorrow’s problem without overcleaning.

daniel.activity: Do a brief low-volume piano session with headphones, then put the headphones back on the piano top. I stop early if Maya needs anything and leave the audio equipment reorganizing for another day.
daniel.intention: Get a small restorative break without disturbing Maya.

daniel.activity: Prepare a simple early dinner with extra broth, carrying the saucepan and bowls to the dining table. I bring Maya a manageable portion and water wherever she is resting, then eat my own portion at the table.
daniel.intention: Make dinner nourishing and low-effort instead of hosting friends tonight.

daniel.activity: Clear the most visible dinner items, check Maya’s temperature and symptoms once more, and make tea if she wants it. I keep the lights low and cancel the drinks-and-dinner hosting plan rather than asking her to manage guests while sick.
daniel.intention: Keep the evening restful and make the change of plans feel ordinary rather than dramatic.

daniel.activity: Sit on the sectional with a book and water while Maya rests, staying available for a quiet check-in. I gather the mug from the bar cart and carry it to the kitchen when I am finished, though I leave the phone there until I notice it.
daniel.intention: Be present without fussing and let both of us decompress.

daniel.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleepwear, and carry a fresh glass of water into bedroom 1. I bring anything Maya needs close to the bed and make sure the room is comfortable for another difficult night.
daniel.intention: Prepare for sleep while setting up practical support for Maya.

daniel.activity: Get into the king bed, keep the lights and conversation low, and listen for Maya without repeatedly waking her. I leave my phone within reach and focus on resting so I can help again tomorrow.
daniel.intention: End the day rested enough to remain quietly vigilant.
